welcome:
Welcome to the OPA (Open Policy Agent) CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore policy authoring, testing, and enforcement.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

scenarios.title: Write and Test an Authorization Policy

steps.instruction: Start by checking the OPA version installed.
Check the syntax of your RBAC authorization policy file.
Format the policy file to enforce consistent style.
Evaluate the allow rule against a sample input to see if user 'alice' can read the accounts resource.
Run the same evaluation with pretty output for easier reading.
steps.hint: Try: opa eval --format pretty -d policy.rego -i input.json "data.authz.allow"

steps.instruction: Run the unit tests to validate all policy rules pass.
Check test coverage to ensure all rules are exercised.
Build the policy bundle for deployment to an OPA server or Kubernetes admission controller.
Check the syntax of all Rego files in the k8s policies directory.
Evaluate the deny rule against a pod spec that requests privileged mode.
Check the deny rule output in pretty format to see the violation messages.
steps.hint: Try: opa eval --format pretty -d k8s/ -i pod-privileged.json "data.kubernetes.admission.deny"

steps.instruction: Test a valid pod that should be allowed (no deny reasons).
steps.hint: Try: opa eval --format pretty -d k8s/ -i pod-valid.json "data.kubernetes.admission.deny"

steps.instruction: Run the Kubernetes policy unit tests with verbose output.
Benchmark the deny rule to check evaluation performance under load.
Use conftest to test Kubernetes manifests against your policies.
Build the k8s policy bundle for deployment to Gatekeeper or OPA sidecar.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  opa eval [expr]            — Evaluate a Rego expression or rule
  opa test [path]            — Run Rego unit tests
  opa check [file]           — Check Rego syntax and types
  opa fmt [file]             — Format Rego source files
  opa build [path]           — Build an OPA bundle (tar.gz)
  opa run [path]             — Start OPA in REPL or server mode
  opa bench [expr]           — Benchmark a Rego expression
  opa parse [file]           — Parse and dump Rego AST
  opa inspect [bundle]       — Inspect a bundle archive
  opa deps [expr]            — Show rule dependencies
  opa capabilities           — Show supported built-in functions
  opa version                — Print OPA version
  conftest test [file]       — Test structured data against policies
  conftest verify            — Verify policy test assertions
  conftest pull [repo]       — Pull policies from a registry

  scenario                   — Start a guided lab
  clear                      — Clear the terminal
  help                       — Show this help

commands.opa parse policy.rego:
package authz

AST:
  Package: data.authz
  Rules:
    - allow (default: false)
      Body:
        - some role in data.roles[input.user]
        - some permission in data.role_permissions[role]
        - permission.action == input.action
        - permission.resource == input.resource
    - allow
      Body:
        - input.user == "admin"
